subject: Temporary role conversion & cross-team coverage for Inference Serving
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary role conversion & cross-team coverage for Inference Serving

Irene / Laura —

Quick heads-up: we have a time-sensitive hole on Serving Runtime next week. Priya's team confirmed an urgent compliance onboarding (gov client) that pulls two SRE cycles for the next 6 weeks; that directly impacts our dedicated inference on-call and a senior infra engineer we had budgeted for Q3 backfill.

Proposal (short):
- Convert one open contractor bench (1 FTE equivalent) to a 6-week temporary full-time coverage for inference on-call and release support.
- Move one junior infra IC (currently on optimization work) to a rotating coverage slot to maintain latency SLOs.
- Request a formal HC waiver so we can avoid the hiring freeze for this short-term conversion and keep the Q3 headcount intact.

I've attached a proposed coverage matrix and a draft waiver form. Cost delta is neutral to the quarter if we avoid a permanent backfill. This is a high-risk window for customer SLAs if we don't act.

Can you confirm ability to approve the temporary conversion and route to HR (HiringOps) for the waiver? If approved, I'll loop in our recruiting partner to convert the contractor and get the onboarding started.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed_coverage_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[attachment: HC_Waiver_Form_2027-04.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary role conversion & cross-team coverage for Inference Serving

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary. I reviewed the matrix briefly; the main risk is downstream velocity on the optimizer work, but I agree the SLA exposure is more pressing. I'm comfortable supporting a temporary conversion if HiringOps signs off and we get explicit timeboxing (no longer than 6 weeks) and a rollback plan.

Action items I need before I route to exec approvals:
- Finalized cost-neutrality calculation (showing comparator vs hiring a perm backfill) — Laura, can you confirm?
- Confirmed start date for contractor conversion and expected ramp (recruiting partner) — Marissa, can you ask NimbusOps?
- HC waiver filled and initial HR stamp (Sarah) — can you confirm process and SLA for decision?

If all three are positive by EOD tomorrow, I'll escalate to People Ops for the waiver exception and copy Finance for the cost note.

Best,
Irene
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Spoke with Nimbus recruiting this morning. Quick summary:
- Contractor candidate (ID: NIM-214) is available to convert on 2027-04-15, two-week ramp to full on-call duties.
- Billing will be moved from contractor bench to a short-term PEO conversion; total cost over 6 weeks is estimated at $28,500 (includes benefits/agency fees).
- Nimbus can guarantee start date contingent on waiver being approved by 2027-04-12.

Attaching cost sheet and marking the items we need HR to confirm.

Subject: Re: Temporary role conversion & cross-team coverage for Inference Serving — HC waiver decision

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear package and the attachments. HR has reviewed the waiver request (HC Waiver Form ID HR-2027-0472) and Finance confirmed the short-term cost delta. Given the SLA risk and the short duration, People Ops is approving the temporary conversion under these conditions:

- Approval window: 2027-04-15 through 2027-05-27 (6 weeks).
- Hiring freeze exception granted only for the named contractor conversion (NIM-214). No additional headcount may be created.
- Weekly check-ins required with Irene + Finance to confirm cost gating and rollback triggers.
- Nimbus must complete onboarding checklist and provide access attestations before 2027-04-15.

Please upload the signed waiver to the HR tracker and mark the case closed once onboarding completes. Sarah (Nimbus) — once you confirm start-of-work, I'll route payroll changes.

Irene — with this confirmation I'll mark the waiver 'approved' and notify Finance to expect the PEO cost transfer.

Regards,
Sarah Wong
HiringOps Consultant
People Ops (external partner)
